N° 02AI video editor2026

Bobine

You film. Bobine does the edit. Footage never leaves the phone.

Visit bobine-tau.vercel.app →Watch the purpose

I

Purpose

Make the edit take minutes instead of evenings, and make the result look like a professional cut: framed, captioned, scored and paced. Built for creators who publish every day and for small teams with no editor.

II

The problem

Editing tools are either too simple to look good or too complex to finish before midnight. Cloud editors ask for gigabytes of uploads on mobile data. Bobine had to be fast, beautiful, private and French first.

III

What I built

A studio where you choose a format, drop your footage and your own music, and an agent plans the cut, edits, reviews and repairs it. Fifteen formats, from vlog and product launch to podcast clip and photo story. A Cinéma room that films AI scenes with a chosen look and camera. A fifty page illustrated guide in two languages, a guided tour, a contact page, and the book that explains the method. Thirteen one minute showcase edits, each in both aspect ratios.

IV

How it works

The engine runs in the browser with WebCodecs, so footage and music stay on the device. Agents cut on the beats of the music. Credits are charged before each AI call and refunded if the call fails. A motion design, Bobine in fifty seconds, explains it in both languages.

V

Craft

Black and ivory, a serif that whispers, real footage everywhere and nothing drawn to fake a sample. French by default, English one tap away.

VI

The purpose, in motion

A short motion design made for this book: four beats, one drawn shape each, the reason the project exists. Tap it to step through.
